tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Search and filter Polish KRS companies (spółki). Compabase also holds the full CEIDG/JDG register; this tool does not browse JDG — those without a public contact email are hidden because of RODO. Default `fields=summary` returns a compact row (name, NIP, KRS, location, PKD, latest financials, email/

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Get the registry profile of one Polish company: name, legal form, address, industry (PKD), share capital, representation rules, recent registry changes, VAT status and headline financials for the latest filed period. Identify the company by name, KRS number or company tax number (NIP). For earlier y

tools.name: get_financials
tools.description: Get full financial statement metrics per fiscal period — all entity_financial_metrics columns. Includes cash_and_equivalents, inventories, receivables, liabilities, equity, cost breakdown, revenue lines. Identify company by name, KRS, or NIP.

tools.name: count_companies
tools.description: Count KRS companies matching given filters. Returns a single number — no company list. Does not count JDG in this tool (full CEIDG is in Compabase; listing is RODO-gated). Sparse or zero counts in JDG-dominated PKDs include a `hint`.

tools.name: get_company_rankings
tools.description: Get a company's revenue rank positions within its industry (PKD), region (voivodeship), and all of Poland. tools.name: get_financial_stats
tools.description: Get precomputed aggregate financial statistics for a sector, region, PKD branch, or country. Returns median, p25/p75/p90, winsorized mean, mean, total, n_companies, min/max. Use for questions like: what is the median revenue / average profit / assets in industry X or region Y? Prefer median or winso

tools.description: Secured liabilities from the latest financial-statement notes (period ending 2025+): mortgages (hipoteki), registered / financial pledges (zastawy), transfers of ownership, assignments — with creditor, amount, secured debt, asset and land-register (KW) numbers. tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Get current billing period usage and remaining quota — mcp_queries, api_requests, export_companies, ask_ai_credits, watchlist_companies. Includes limits and reset date.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "financials" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_companies · Private data: search_companies · Public sink: search_companies, get_company · Destructive: get_usage.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_companies · Private data: search_companies · Public sink: search_companies, get_company · Destructive: get_usage

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
